P(cid:3450)(cid:3467)(cid:3469) IV (A) – GAZETTE  EXTRAORDINARY  OF  THE  DEMOCRATIC  SOCIALIST  REPUBLIC  OF SRI  LANKA – 19.12.2019
Agreement
empowered by article 30 subsection (1) of the Southern Province Irrigation Precept, as the second party, on ................ Day
of the month of ..................... in the year .................. signed in Galle, shall be known as declared below.
The  ﬁ rst  party  has  title  to  the  property  described  in  the  schedule  below  of  deed  no  ..................,  certiﬁ ed  on  .................
by Attorney  at  Law  and  Notary  Public  ...............................................  and  he  is  the  legitimate  owner  of  that  property.  In
furtherance, the ﬁ rst party has made an application, no ............... to the second party, to obtain a recommendation to put up,
a Border wall / an Entrance gate / other construction, at the pace called .................................... described in the schedule
below, within the irrigation reserve.
Accordingly, the ﬁ rst party  so named, shall herewith agree to, dismantle and withdraw clear the Border wall / an Entrance
gate / other construction or part thereof, with no claim of damages or compensation what so ever, at the ﬁ rst party’s own
expense, from ....................................... in the section that falls within the Irrigation reserve ............................. from the bank
of the rivulet, in the event that such dismantling is required for the purpose of, either broadening the rivulet of for whatever
other requirement of the Southern Provincial Council.
Therefore, the ﬁ rst party herewith agree to abide by the existing laws, or laws that would be enacted in the future, with regard
to broadening rivulets, border walls, entrance gates, other constructions or on reserve limits.
